title: Hiring: Data Analytics & Data Science Faculty / Technical Trainer
description:
**Company:** Baroda Institute of Technology (BIT Gandhinagar)  
**Location:** 3rd Floor, Super Mall 1, Infocity, Gandhinagar, Gujarat – 382007  
**Job Type:** Full-Time  
**Experience:** 0–2Years Preferred  
**Salary:** Negotiable, based on skills and experience

About BIT Gandhinagar

Baroda Institute of Technology (BIT) is an IT training institute focused on practical, industry-oriented learning. We help students and working professionals develop technical skills through hands-on training, live projects, and career-focused learning programs.

We are looking for passionate and skilled **Data Analytics and Data Science Faculty / Technical Trainers** who can teach students through practical sessions and real-world projects.

Key Responsibilities

* Conduct practical training sessions in Data Analytics, Data Science, and Artificial Intelligence.
* Teach technical concepts with real-world examples and hands-on exercises.
* Guide students through assignments, case studies, and live projects.
* Develop training materials, exercises, and project-based learning activities.
* Help students build industry-relevant technical and problem-solving skills.
* Prepare students for technical interviews and career opportunities.
* Evaluate student performance and provide constructive feedback.
* Stay updated with current industry technologies and tools.

Required Technical Skills

**Data Analytics:**

* Microsoft Excel and Advanced Excel
* SQL and Database Management
* Power BI and Dashboard Development
* Data Cleaning, Data Visualization, and Reporting
* Business Analytics and Data Interpretation

**Data Science:**

* Python Programming
* NumPy and Pandas
* Statistics and Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA)
* Machine Learning fundamentals
* Scikit-learn and model evaluation
* Artificial Intelligence and Generative AI fundamentals
* Practical projects using real-world datasets

Candidates with expertise in either Data Analytics or Data Science are encouraged to apply. Candidates with knowledge of both domains will be preferred.

Eligibility Criteria

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, IT, Data Science, Statistics, or a related field.
* 0–2 years of relevant industry or teaching experience preferred.
* Strong practical knowledge of the relevant technical tools.
* Good communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to explain complex technical concepts in a simple and understandable way.
* Passion for teaching and mentoring students.

Freshers with strong technical knowledge, practical project experience, and excellent communication skills may also apply.

What We Offer

* Opportunity to work in a practical, industry-oriented learning environment.
* Opportunity to mentor students and aspiring technology professionals.
* Supportive and professional working environment.
* Salary negotiable based on skills, experience, and teaching ability.
* Opportunities to develop technical training and mentoring skills.

How to Apply

Interested candidates can apply through Indeed by submitting their updated resume.

Shortlisted candidates will be invited for a technical interview and a short demo lecture to assess their subject knowledge, practical skills, and teaching ability.

**Job Location:** BIT Gandhinagar, Infocity, Gujarat.

We look forward to welcoming talented and passionate trainers to our team!

Pay: ₹300,000.00 - ₹480,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Flexible schedule
* Leave encashment
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

title: Data Science Trainer
description:
Job Summery:

A Data Science Trainer is responsible for teaching various modules of Data Science as per the curriculum. They deliver training sessions, prepare learning materials, and assess the progress of learners. The role demands strong expertise in data analytics, programming, machine learning, deep learning, and emerging AI technologies. A Data Science Trainer must be able to simplify complex technical concepts, demonstrate practical applications, and communicate effectively. They play a key rolein shaping learners into skilled data professionals who can work with real-world datasets and industry-relevant tools.

Roles & Responsibilities:

* Conducting classroom or online lectures on Data Science, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, AI, SQL, Python, and related technologies.
* Assigning and evaluating practical exercises, projects, and data-driven case studies.
* Guiding students one-on-one with coding support, doubt-solving, and project mentoring.
* Ensuring that the course curriculum is updated, practical, and aligned with current industry needs.
* Collaborating with other trainers and content developers to create and improve training materials.
* Maintaining accurate records of student performance, attendance, and progress reports.
* Creating a positive, engaging, and hands-on learning environment for students.
* Participating in faculty meetings, workshops, and continuous professional development activities.
* Keeping up-to-date with the latest advancements in Data Science tools, frameworks, and technologies.

Contact : 8655301282

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person
